list.text: Karthikeya's recitation of the Śivapadams was truly remarkable. The clarity of pronunciation, the depth of feeling, and the devotion in one so young is a rare and precious gift. May he continue to illuminate the tradition.
list.role: Renowned Telugu Scholar & Poet · Sydney Visit

list.text: It is heartening to see the next generation embrace Sanskrit with such commitment and joy. His performance in the Olympiad reflects both extraordinary natural talent and deeply disciplined practice.
During Navarātri, Karthikeya's pārāyaṇa of Soundaryalaharī filled our temple with a truly sacred vibration. Such devotion and memorisation from a 10-year-old is nothing short of divine grace.
